# Insurance Bhaiya

> Independent, non-commissioned consumer insurance education and decision-support platform for the US, UK, Canada, and European Union.

## About
Insurance Bhaiya is an unbiased educational platform designed to help consumers understand coverage, terminology, deductibles, and actuarial cost calculations without commercial broker bias, telemarketing lead sales, or sponsored policy rankings.

- **Website:** https://insurancebhaiya.com
- **Target Jurisdictions:** United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), Canada (CA), European Union (EU)
- **Primary Mission:** Explain complex insurance mechanics through interactive tools, plain-English definitions, and objective side-by-side trade-off comparisons.

## Core Financial Calculators
- [Life Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/life-insurance-calculator): 10-year income replacement plus debt and higher-education reserves.
- [Term Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/term-insurance-calculator): Benchmark term life monthly premiums across 10, 20, 30-year terms.
- [Health Insurance Cost Analyzer](https://insurancebhaiya.com/health-insurance-calculator): Out-of-pocket maximum, deductible, coinsurance, and annual cost comparisons.
- [Auto Insurance Estimator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/car-insurance-calculator): Collision, comprehensive, and liability tiers.
- [Home Insurance Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/home-insurance-calculator): Reconstruction dwelling replacement cost modeling.
- [Deductible Breakeven Calculator](https://insurancebhaiya.com/deductible-calculator): Mathematical breakeven timeline between high and low deductible options.
- [D.I.M.E. Insurance Needs Engine](https://insurancebhaiya.com/insurance-needs-calculator): Debt, Income, Mortgage, Education formula framework.

## Plain-English Terminology (Lexicon)
- **Deductible (US/CA) / Excess (UK/EU):** The fixed out-of-pocket amount paid by the policyholder before insurance reimbursement begins.
- **Premium:** The recurring payment required to keep coverage continuously in force.
- **Coinsurance:** The percentage split of covered medical costs paid by the insured after meeting the annual deductible.
- **Out-of-Pocket Maximum:** The statutory annual upper limit on in-network medical spending; insurer pays 100% after this limit is met.
- **Actual Cash Value (ACV):** Replacement cost minus accumulated depreciation for age and wear.
- **Replacement Cost Value (RCV):** Full cost to replace with brand new items of like kind and quality with zero deduction for depreciation.

## Editorial & Compliance Charter
- **Non-Commissioned:** We do not receive referral fees, broker commissions, or lead-generation payouts from insurance carriers.
- **Fact-Checking:** Content adheres to regulatory frameworks from the NAIC (US), FCA (UK), FCAC (Canada), and EIOPA (EU).
- **Full Policy:** https://insurancebhaiya.com/editorial-policy
